NFL QB Club 2002.name: NFL QB Club 2002
NFL QB Club 2002.summary:
NFL QB Club 2002 is a football video game developed and published by Acclaim Entertainment under their Acclaim Sports banner. It is the final game in Acclaim's NFL Quarterback Club series. Some of the game's key features are:

NFL Quarterback Challenge mode, featuring four head-to-head events: Speed and Mobility, Accuracy, Long Distance Throw and Read & Recognition.
Unlock retired players like John Elway, Dan Marino, Steve Young, Jim Kelly and Phil Simms
31 NFL clubs and over 1500 NFL players.
Play-by-play from Kevin Harlan and color commentary from Bill Maas.
Player models feature blinking eyes, jaw motions, facial expressions and removable helmets.
Player injuries, penalties and weather conditions affect season play and individual player performance.
5 modes of play: Season, Exhibition, Challenge Mode, Playoffs, and Pro Bowl

Skies of Arcadia Legends.name: Skies of Arcadia Legends
Skies of Arcadia Legends.summary:
Skies of Arcadia Legends is an enhanced GameCube port of Skies of Arcadia. It follows the air pirate Vyse and his companions as they explore a world of floating continents and oppose the Valuan Empire, which seeks to awaken the ancient Gigas using six powerful Moon Stones. Players travel by airship, explore towns and dungeons, recruit crew members, discover hidden locations, and engage in turn-based character and ship battles.

The GameCube version retains the original story and gameplay while adding new characters, side content, backstory, collectible items, music, and changes to the reputation and battle systems. Content previously distributed online for the Dreamcast version is also included within the game.
